about: What each recogniser hears in the app's MP3 of every line (tools/hear-sound.py): a clip of one recording whole, a clip put together from lines cut at its cues. heard: for each recogniser what it wrote in three hearings: padded, trimmed, bare (the clip as it ships with 150 ms of silence round it; without its air; as it ships and nothing round it). wrong: for each hearing, the recognisers whose letters are not the line's. heard_wrong: every recogniser wrong in two hearings of the three or more. fails: why the clip may not ship as it is (short, a word silent.json names, a form its lesson calls wrong); a row with fails is a line of a listening item that a person has not ruled on, or is named under "keep". tried: the seeds it was said again with, none of which passed (it is not said again while its MP3 is this one). sha: the SHA-1 of the MP3 that was heard; a line whose MP3 is the same is not heard again.
